title: EC 1.2.7: UMAP of k-sep. bigram PSSM
caption: UMAP projection of all 550 proteins in the EC 1.2.7 pool, described by k-sep. bigram PSSM (400 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.25. Axes have no units, and distances between far-apart clusters are not meaningful. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
